description: Agent preflight: check an operator’s continuity arrangements before you rely on the operator. Input text, fields (key_custody, successor, standing_jobs, subscriptions, escrowed_work, records_export) or both. The signed report marks each area covered, partial or not covered, with quotes, and names the gaps plainly: a single point of failure in key custody, no successor, no plan for standing jobs, subscriptions or escrowed work, and no export path for records. POST /api/continuity-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The arrangements by area. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that area.

escrowed_work.description: What happens to escrowed funds and work in progress.

key_custody.description: Who holds the signing keys and credentials, and any backup or recovery for them.

records_export.description: How and where the records are exported.

standing_jobs.description: What happens to standing or scheduled jobs if the operator stops.

subscriptions.description: What happens to subscriptions and recurring charges.

successor.description: The successor or recovery contact who takes over.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The continuity arrangements as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_continuity-check
title: Continuity check
